plan.title: Draft line item rejects zero quantity

steps.note: Open the events list to reach the saved draft.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Switch to the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Open the first available saved eRFX draft without inventing an event title.
Open the Manage Line Items window for the draft's existing line item.
Enter the invalid zero quantity specified by the case.
Enter the price specified by the case before attempting to save.
Attempt to save the edited line item.

args.text: Please fill valid quantity on every line item

steps.note: Assert that Procol refuses the save because the quantity is zero.
